changes.title: Man arrested after lunging at Ohio candidate for governor
changes.summary: A man was arrested after lunging at Ohio’s Democratic gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton. Witnesses say he pushed his way through a crowd holding a cell phone. Her security detail prevented him from reaching her. NBC News’ Maggie Vespa reports.
